entries.requirement_text: The `git_created` field shall be `true` when local Git initialization has completed inside `repository/`. The `validation_completed` field shall become `true` only when report finalization has successfully serialized, written, and consistency-verified the finalized validation report; the `validation_overall_status` field shall then record the overall_status value (pass or fail) from that finalized validation report. During report finalization, a proposed staging-state representation shall be constructed in memory with `validation_completed` equal to `true` and `validation_overall_status` equal to the proposed overall result, validated against this schema without writing, and written durably to `transaction/staging-state.json` only after the finalized validation report has been written. The staging-state record must not claim `validation_completed` equal to `true` before the validation report has been successfully serialized and written. The staging-state record and the validation report shall share matching `request_fingerprint` and `repository_content_digest` values.

entries.requirement_text: The `cleanup_failure` field shall be a required nullable field that is always present in every staging-state record. When cleanup has not been attempted or when cleanup succeeds, `cleanup_failure` shall be `null`. When post-promotion staging-root removal fails after `promotion_outcome` is `promoted`, `cleanup_failure` shall be a non-empty diagnostic string describing the cleanup failure reason; the presence of a non-null `cleanup_failure` value does not change the promotion outcome. The deterministic serialized forms are: normal state — `"cleanup_failure": null`; cleanup-failure state — `"cleanup_failure": "<non-empty diagnostic string>"`. The canonical cleanup-failure staging-state is: `current_stage` = `success-finalization`, `failed_stage` = `success-finalization`, `completed_stages` includes `promotion` (completed) and does not include `success-finalization` (not completed), `promotion_entered` = `true`, `promotion_outcome` = `promoted`, and `cleanup_failure` = non-empty diagnostic string. No automatic rollback or retry of the failed cleanup operation is authorized.
